rationale: Before mitigation only 8/10 values (80%) lie in the normal band [0.90, 1.10] pu, below the 95% requirement, and t03/t04 fall under 0.90 pu, so the series is non-compliant. Among the listed additive tap changes, +0.025 pu raises every sample into [0.90, 1.10] pu (10/10) while keeping all values within the absolute limits [0.85, 1.10] pu; +0.05 pu pushes t09 to 1.116 pu, violating the absolute upper limit, and 0.0/-0.025 pu leave samples out of band. Therefore +0.025 pu is recommended.
